segments.speaker: CLERK
segments.en: Conference Centre Reservations. Good morning.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Hi. I'm interested in the computing conference next month.

segments.speaker: CLERK
segments.en: Future Directions in Computing?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Yes, that's right. Could I ask you a few questions about it?

segments.speaker: CLERK
segments.en: Of course.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: OK. I know the conference is for three days but actually I want to attend on the Friday and Saturday only. Will that work out to be any cheaper?

segments.speaker: CLERK
segments.en: Let me have a look. Well, you could register for the two days separately, but tbat wouldn't actually save you very much as it still costs £35 for each day. In fact, if you could register for the three days, you also get an invitation to a free dinner on the Saturday night, so that's probably the better option.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Right, I'll do that. How much will the fees be in that case?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: All right. I'd like to register for the full three days. Now, can I pay that by credit card?

segments.speaker: CLERK
segments.en: I'm afraid not. You'll have to send a cheque to us, or you can pay at the conference office.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Fine. So it's probably easiest if I pay by cheque. Now then, what else do I need to arrange? Right. How about accommodation? I guess that's not included in the price?

segments.speaker: CLERK
segments.en: No, I'm sorry, it's not, but we do have a few rooms available for delegates at the conference centre if you'd like. Those are very cheap but if you're interested you'll need to book soon, because there's always a heavy demand for them. They are only ill per night, but they are very basic and you'd have to get your own breakfast, because they don't provide you with that. But it's very convenient, because it's in the same building as the conference rooms.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Uhuh.

segments.speaker: CLERK
segments.en: Or there's a very reasonable guest house which is £25 per night. And I think that includes your breakfast.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Is it close to the conference centre?

segments.speaker: CLERK
segments.en: It would be about a ten-minute walk away from here.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: I see. That sounds quite reasonable.

segments.speaker: CLERK
segments.en: The details are all in our conference pack, which I'll send you.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Great, thanks. That'll be very useful. Oh, and can you also send me an application form?

segments.speaker: CLERK
segments.en: Of course. I'll get that in the post to you straight away. Is there anything else?

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Yes, actually. Can you tell me where exactly the conference centre is?

segments.speaker: CLERK
segments.en: Well, it's on South Park Road and it's right at the end of the road next to the library. It's a ten-minute taxi ride from the station and will QB cost you £1_. Otherwise, you can take the bus which runs every half an hour from the station - that's the 21A - and it brings you straight to the conference centre.

segments.speaker: WOMAN
segments.en: Right, got that.
